primary_channel_weights.semantics: all whitened EEG/MEG channels equal one only for primary H0/H1 fit and primary held-out gate score

deep_channel_weights.semantics: original training-derived modality evidence weights retained only for deep LOO selection and deep amplitude/refit

conditional_surface_channel_weights.semantics: frozen W=1 on every whitened channel for conditional-surface train20 and combined40 fits

secondary_rule: primary gate closed: end-to-end null score is zero
